messages:
maria (People Ops): Heads-up: were opening an additional evening calibration slot tonight (22:00 PT) to help teams in APAC & EMEA avoid ratings handback delays. This is an extra live session for on-the-fence cases only — not for revising whole packets. :earth_africa:

oleg (Eng Manager): Thanks @maria. Quick Q: if a rating needs to change after the live slot, what is the approved path? We have 2 borderline cases and might want to bump one up after discussion.

maria (People Ops): Good question. During the evening slot we can approve rating edits only with: a) manager rationale in the packet, b) 1 peer corroboration or evidence, and c) signoff from the session lead. Any edits will be logged and trigger a small recalculation of distribution buckets (transparent to folks).

harpreet (People Ops): Note: to keep the session efficient, please pre-flag any "on-the-fence" ICs by tagging them in the pre-calibration sheet: https://internal.redwood.com/calib-sheet. Use column X "evening-slot-flag" and add a 1-line reason. We'll pull that list at 21:30 PT.

dave (Manager): Oleg and I flagged two folks. Is the evening packet separate from the main calibration packet or merged later?

calib-bot: packet generated: evening_slot_2026-07-29_2130PT.csv  12 rows pulled from master packet; checksum 3f7a

maria (People Ops): Its merged after the session. We keep an audit trail: original_packet + evening_edits. Also policy: any edit after the merged packet but before finalization needs HR lead approval (small exception flow).

oleg (Eng Manager): For transparency, can we get a short diff report of ratings changed during the evening slot?

harpreet (People Ops): Yes  we publish a one-page diff and anonymized rationale summary to the review console under "calibration/audit" within 24 hours. If you want more detailed notes DM me and we'll arrange restricted access.

dave (Manager): One practical: can the session run slightly earlier for teams in IST? 22:00 PT is 9:30AM IST, which is okay but tight for folks in Asia Pacific.

maria (People Ops): We'll rotate the extra slot weekly between 22:00 PT and 02:00 PT to be fair across regions. If you have recurring conflicts, add to the sheet and we'll prioritize your timezone next week.

oleg (Eng Manager): Last thing  any change to the handback window timing? We had a few folks expecting handback by Friday EOD.

maria (People Ops): No change to the official handback deadline (Friday 17:00 PT). The evening slot is just to reduce bottlenecks in calibration decisions so managers can meet that handback SLA. We'll post a follow-up note when the session finishes. :white_check_mark:
